description: Header file defining the CUDAGuardImpl class, which implements device and stream management for CUDA devices in PyTorch.

classes.name: CUDAGuardImpl
classes.description: Implementation of device and stream management for CUDA devices in PyTorch.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the device type, which is CUDA.

methods.name: exchangeDevice
methods.description: Switches the current device to the specified device and returns the previous device.

methods.name: getDevice
methods.description: Returns the current CUDA device.

methods.name: uncheckedGetDevice
methods.description: Returns the current CUDA device without throwing exceptions, or nullopt if unavailable.

methods.name: setDevice
methods.description: Sets the current device to the specified CUDA device.

methods.name: uncheckedSetDevice
methods.description: Sets the device without throwing exceptions.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Returns the current CUDA stream for the specified device.

methods.name: getDefaultStream
methods.description: Returns the default CUDA stream for the specified device.

methods.name: getNewStream
methods.description: Creates and returns a new CUDA stream with optional priority.

methods.name: getStreamFromGlobalPool
methods.description: Returns a CUDA stream from the global pool with optional high priority.

methods.name: exchangeStream
methods.description: Replaces the current stream with a new one and returns the old stream.

methods.name: deviceCount
methods.description: Returns the number of CUDA devices available.

methods.name: createEvent
methods.description: Creates a CUDA event with specified flags.

methods.name: destroyEvent
methods.description: Destroys a CUDA event.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Records a CUDA event on a stream.

methods.name: block
methods.description: Makes a stream wait for a CUDA event.

methods.name: queryEvent
methods.description: Checks if a CUDA event has completed.

methods.name: queryStream
methods.description: Checks if a CUDA stream is active.

methods.name: synchronizeStream
methods.description: Synchronizes a CUDA stream.

methods.name: synchronizeEvent
methods.description: Synchronizes a CUDA event.

methods.name: synchronizeDevice
methods.description: Synchronizes the specified CUDA device.

methods.name: recordDataPtrOnStream
methods.description: Records a data pointer on a CUDA stream.

methods.name: elapsedTime
methods.description: Calculates elapsed time between two CUDA events.
